ref: Mɔxexeɖenu siawo dometɔ ɖekae nye be, ne nyɔnu fɔ fu la, mele be wòakpɔ nusiwo woɣla o.
translated: Ɖeka le ŋɔsèwo me enye be, ne nyɔnu aɖe le fu me la, mele be yeakpɔ nusiwo wòɖe ŋu ɖa o.

text: Part of the money collected from taxes contributes to the building of roads.
ref: Ga si woxɔ le adzɔwo me la ƒe akpa aɖee nye mɔwo tutuna.
translated: Ga si woɖe le fetɔwo ŋu la, eƒe akpa ɖeka kpɔna mɔwo ŋuŋu ŋu.

text: When the citizens were gathered at Buckingham palace waiting for the news concerning the Queen's health, some bursted into tears when they heard the death of the Queen.
ref: Esi dumeviawo ƒo ƒu ɖe Buckingham fiasã me nɔ nyadzɔdzɔ si ku ɖe Fianyɔnua ƒe lãmesẽ ŋu lalam la, wo dometɔ aɖewo fa avi esi wose Fianyɔnua ƒe ku.
translated: Esi dukɔa ƒe amewo ƒo ƒu le Buckingham ahiame le ŋudɔ ƒe nyagbalẽ si kpɔ kple Fiaga nyɔnua ƒe lãmesẽfafa ta la, ame aɖewo ƒe avi tsro esi woɖo se bena Fiaga nyɔnua ku la.

text: Malaria testing kits are helping people living in rural remote areas in the absence of a doctor
ref: Nugbagbevi suesuesue siwo wowɔ kpɔ la le kpekpem ɖe ame siwo le nuto siwo me kɔƒe didiwo me ne ɖɔkta aɖeke mele o la ŋu
translated: Malaria dɔ dodokpɔ nu aɖewo le kpekpeɖeŋu na ame siwo le agble dzi kple teƒe siwo le ɖoɖo le dɔkta manɔmee

text: The district has properly planned for the youths and their future.
ref: Nutomea wɔ ɖoɖo nyuie ɖe sɔhɛawo kple woƒe etsɔme ŋu.
translated: Ðeka la wɔ mɔnu nyuie na dokuiwo kple woƒe edziedzi.

text: The support team helped her with her basic needs.
ref: Kpekpeɖeŋunaha la kpe ɖe eŋu le eƒe nuhiahiã veviwo me.
translated: Alɔ̃ɖoɖo ƒe ha la kpe ɖe eŋu le eƒe nakeke hiatɔwo me.

text: The headteacher was sacked over alleged involvement in the last week strike.
ref: Woɖe nufialagã la le dɔme le esi wogblɔ be ekpɔ gome le dɔmedzoedoname si wowɔ le kwasiɖa si va yi me ta.
translated: Wòɖe ƒoƒo suku ɖase la le dɔ me le eƒe ŋkume le kwasiɖa si pase la me ƒe lakpa gã la me.

text: The pope is the chief pastor of the worldwide catholic church.
ref: Popue nye nunɔla ga ne katoliko hame la le xexe blibo la katã me.
translated: Pope la nye fiala tsitsi na Katolik ha gbɔxɔxɔ la katã le xexeame.

text: Some poor people consume all their money with holding back any little for savings.
ref: Ame dahe aɖewo ɖua woƒe gawo katã eye wometea ŋu ɖua ga o.
translated: Ame aɖewo ɖua ga siwo katã woƒo be woatsɔ aɖe aƒo nu o.

text: The Mayor made sure all the roads in our town are properly constructed.
ref: Dumegã la kpɔ egbɔ be wotu mɔ siwo katã le míaƒe dua me la nyuie.
translated: Dutofia la kpɔ egbɔ be wotutu mɔ siwo katã le mía dua me la nyuie.

text: The district will enforce environmental laws with an aim of conserving the environment.
ref: Nutomea awɔ nu sia nu si wòate ŋui atsɔ akpɔ nutoa me ƒe dedienɔnɔ ta.
translated: Nutikpɔkpɔa na de se siwo kpɔ dzi na nuti la dzi be woakpɔ nutikɔnu la dzi.

text: We were educated about self-defense as people are always educated on how to protect children's rights in the community.
ref: Wofia nu mí tso ɖokui taʋiʋli ŋu elabena wofiaa nu amewo ɣesiaɣi tso alesi woakpɔ ɖeviwo ƒe gomenɔamesiwo ta le nutoa me ŋu.
translated: Wofia nu mi le ɖokuiŋuti megbe abe alesi wofia nu ame kple alesi woakpɔ ɖevi ƒe gomekpɔkpɔ ta le du me ene.

text: Roads should be constructed in areas which are not linked with people's land.
ref: Ele be woatu mɔwo ɖe nuto siwo me womate ŋu ado ƒome kple amewo ƒe anyigba o la me o.
translated: Mɔwo ŋu si wòawɔ le afisiwo me dometɔwo ƒe anyigba mele o.

text: She constantly strives for excellence in her work, and never settles for mediocrity.
ref: Edzea agbagba ɣesiaɣi be yeawɔ nu nyui na yeƒe dɔwo, eye gbeɖegbeɖea koe.
translated: Eya ƒe dzidzedzem le eƒe dɔwɔwɔ me gã ɖe edzi, eye mele enu madzi dzi nɔnɔm dzi o.

text: In severe cases, it can cause jaundice, seizures, coma, or death.
ref: Ne ame aɖe sesẽ la, ate ŋu ahe ƒuƒlui, ame ƒe hoho, eƒe ɖiƒoƒo, eƒe ɖuɖu alo eƒe ku vɛ.
translated: Le ŋuwo si le vevie me la, ate ŋu ana ame ŋu nayɛ, ado agbãgba, ade kɔme, alo aku.

text: Archaeological remains found in the coastal zone indicate that the area has been inhabited since the Bronze Age (ca. 2000 BC), but these societies, based on fishing in the extensive lagoons and rivers, have left few traces.
ref: Nu gbagbeŋutinunyala siwo kpɔtɔ le ƒutanutoa me ɖee fia be tso Bronze Ƒe (ca.20000 BC) me la, nutoa me tɔwo nɔa nutoa me, gake habɔbɔ siawo nɔa tɔmelã siwo le tɔmelãwo me kple tɔsisiwo me la me.
translated: Nutikpɔkpɔ xoxowo si woɖe le ƒuƒoƒe nutome me fia be amewo nɔ teƒe sia le Dzesi Xeye me (abe ƒe 2000 Klisto ŋgɔ ene), gake habɔbɔ siawo, siwo do ɖoɖo le tɔmedela dɔwɔwɔ le tɔsiwo kple toɖofewo me, wometso ɖe kpɔɖeŋu geɖe o.

text: True to his promise to reduce the number of Ministerial appointees and run a lean government, the number of Ministers was significantly reduced from 87 of the previous Kufuor NPP government to 73 (a reduction of 16%) in the Mills-led government.
ref: Abe alesi wòdo ŋugbe be yeaɖe amesiwo wotia be woanye dziɖuɖumegãwo ƒe xexlẽme dzi akpɔtɔ eye yeana dziɖuɖua nanɔ te sesĩe ene la, woɖe dziɖuɖumegãwo ƒe xexlẽme dzi kpɔtɔ tso 87 le Kufuor NPP dziɖuɖua si va yi me va ɖo 73 (si nye 16%) le Mills dziɖuɖua me.
translated: Abe ale si wòdo ŋkuɖe be yeagbɔ amesiame ƒe xexlẽdzesiwo ƒe nɔnɔme aɖe kpɔ eye wòaƒo dɔ kple dziɖuɖu la, Ministertɔwo ƒe xexlẽme la ɖi tso 87 si Kufuor ƒe NPP ƒe dziɖuɖu do ŋgɔ la me va 73 (eƒe ɖiɖi enye 16%) le Mills ƒe dziɖuɖu la me.

text: Aeroplanes serve as the fastest method of transportation today.
ref: Aƒetɔviwo wɔa dɔ egbea be ʋuwo ƒe mɔ kpuietɔ kekeake.
translated: Yavuɖoƒe (aeroplane) wɔna mɔ kasiame nu le ɖoɖo me ɣe sia ɣe.

text: The peoples' hostility is complicating the health workers' job of suppressing outbreaks.
ref: Ameawo ƒe fuléle le lãmesẽdɔwɔlawo ƒe dɔ si nye be woatsi dɔvɔ̃wo nu la le sesẽm ɖe edzi.
translated: Dukɔa ƒe dɔmedzui le dɔwɔla siwo le ŋkudzɔdzɔm dɔ wɔm la ƒe dɔ la wɔm vevẽ na.

text: Some men do not provide for their families, and they abandon girls after impregnating them.
ref: Some men do not provide for their families, and they abandon girls after impregnating them.
translated: Ŋutsuwo ɖewo mekpea wo ƒe ŋutilawo nu o, eye wogblẽa nyɔnuvi siwo wo dó fu la te.

text: The porcupine is a very elusive and hard animal to kill.
ref: Kotoko nye lã si womate ŋu asi le bɔbɔe o eye wòsesẽna be woawu.
translated: Kotey ƒe kpɔkpɔ sesẽ eye wuwu hã sesẽ ŋutɔ.

text: People were advised to work hard for their church and family.
ref: Woɖo aɖaŋu na amewo be woawɔ dɔ sesẽ ɖe woƒe sɔlemeha kple woƒe ƒomea ta.
translated: Ame siwo le afimá wɔ aɖaŋu be woawɔ dɔ sesẽ na wo ƒe hame kple wo ƒe ŋutilã.

text: The people of Twifo Praso used the saterlite to connect to other parts of the world.
ref: Twifo Prasotɔwo zã satelait la tsɔ do ka kple xexeame ƒe akpa bubuwo.
translated: Twifo Praso tɔwo zã satellite la dze ka ɖe xexeame fɔfɔwo.

text: States, tribes, and local communities can create environments that are supportive of women’s health and tailored to local needs and challenges.
ref: Dukɔwo, towo, kple nutoa me tɔwo ate ŋu awɔ nɔnɔme siwo ado alɔ nyɔnuwo ƒe lãmesẽ eye woasɔ ɖe nutoa me ƒe nuhiahiãwo kple kuxiwo nu.
translated: Dukɔwo, akɔta siwo kple nutɔtɔwo kple nutifegbeƒe hawo ate ŋu aɖo nɔƒewo si woatsɔ akpɔ nyɔnuwo ƒe lãmesese gbɔ eye woatrɔ asi le eƒe teƒe ƒe hiadodo kple gbeƒãɖeɖe wo ŋu.

text: This made him to come and pick some of his people to add up and to teach Asanteman sense.
ref: Esia na wòva tia eƒe amewo dometɔ aɖewo be yeatsɔ aƒo ƒu eye yeafia Asanteman sidzedze.
translated: Eya ta wòva tsɔ eʋegbetɔwo ɖewo kpe ɖe eŋu be woafia Asanteawo nyansa.

text: This shocked her so much that she even considered taking her life, as she couldn’t see any way she could support herself with that little money each month.
ref: Esia wɔ nuku nɛ ale gbegbe be ebu eŋu gɔ̃ hã be yeaɖe yeƒe agbe ɖa, elabena mete ŋu kpɔ mɔ aɖeke si dzi yeato akpɔ ye ɖokui dzi kple ga sue ma ɣleti sia ɣleti o.
translated: Esia dze eŋu ŋutɔ aɖe bɔbɔe ale si gbe ebu tame hã be yeawu eɖokui, elabena mekpɔ mɔ aɖeke si dzi yeate ŋu akpɔ eɖokui nu le ga sue ma me ɣleti sia ɣleti o.

text: These elders are sometimes women who wont give birth again due to their experience to help others.
ref: Hamemetsitsi siawo nyea nyɔnu ɣeaɖewoɣi siwo magadzi vi ake o le woƒe nuteƒekpɔkpɔ be woakpe ɖe ame bubuwo ŋu ta.
translated: Ame tsitsi siawo ɖoɖoe ŋutsu nye nyɔnuwo si womagabi vi o azɔ le woƒe nunyanya ta be woakpe ɖe ame bubuwo ŋu.

text: Border districts are greatly affected by the Pandemic.
ref: Nuto siwo me dome gblẽa nu le ŋunye la gblẽa nu le ŋutɔ.
translated: Ƒe ƒomea ƒomea siwo le ŋugbe dzi la, Covid-19 ŋutilãdzedze la wɔ nu vɛ na wo ŋutɔ.

text: The people resorted to mob justice to solve the ongoing land disputes.
ref: Ameawo to nuvlowɔhawo ƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzi be yewoakpɔ anyigba ŋuti nyaʋiʋli siwo nɔ edzi yim la gbɔ.
translated: Ame siwo le afimɑ wɔ gbeɖeɖe to ŋkuwo me be woaɖe anyigbadzɔdzɔmenya siwo le edzi yiyi me la ɖo.

text: Local defence officer broke into my neighbour's home.
ref: Aʋawɔla si le míaƒe aƒelikawo gbɔ va míaƒe aƒe me.
translated: Nutikpla tso ƒoƒo me gba ɖo ƒe me na tonɔnyea.

text: In a case where two or more people were heading to a place and one or some of them decided to take the lead, when they got to a junction, they put leaves on the path they took so as to inform the others behind them of where they passed.
ref: Le nya aɖe si me ame eve alo esi wu nenema ɖo ta teƒe aɖe eye wo dometɔ ɖeka alo wo dometɔ aɖewo tso nya me be yewoaxɔ ŋgɔ la, ne woɖo mɔdodo aɖe dzi la, wotsɔa aŋgbawo dana ɖe mɔ si dzi woto la dzi ale be woana ame mamlɛ siwo le megbe na wo la nanya afi si wole woto eme va yi.
translated: Ne ame eve alo ame geɖewo le gome yi teƒe aɖe eye wo dometɔ ɖeka alo woɖewo ɖo be yewo aɖe mo aɖe na wo la, ne wodo ŋgɔ va tsi mo aɖaɖoƒe la, wode amagbale ɖa mo si dzi wotsɔ la dzi be woana amesiwo le megbe la nanya mo si dzi wodo.

text: Women believe in traditional birth attendants more than in hospital staff.
ref: Nyɔnuwo ate ŋu awɔ dɔ si ŋutsuwo wɔna eye woaga ate ŋu awɔ dɔwɔɖuia si ŋtsuwo wɔna hã.
translated: Nyɔnuwo xɔ se ɖe amesiwo kpɔna fu le aƒewo me nu wu dɔkta siwo le kɔdzi nu.

text: Then 35% of them manage to complete secondary school (SHS). The reasons for the decline in primary, secondary, and high school completion rates may include early dropout, replacement, and early dropout.
ref: Emegbe wo dometɔ blaetɔ̃ vɔ atɔ̃ le alafa me te ŋu wu sekɛndrisuku (SHS) nu. Nusiwo gbɔ gɔmedzesuku, sekɛndrisuku, kple sekɛndrisuku wuwu ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ dzi ɖe kpɔtɔ ate ŋu anye be wodzudzɔ sukudede kaba, wo ɖɔli wo nɔewo, kple wo dzudzɔ kaba.
translated: Eyome la, wo ƒe 35% ko woa kpɔ ŋu srɔ̃ sekondri sukuu (SHS) nu. Nusiwo ŋuti akɔntabubu le ɖiɖi le primary, sekondri, kple sukuu ɖeɖe ƒe gɔmedzedzenu me ɖe anyi la nye susu tso sukuu le ŋgɔgbe, ɖoɖo ƒe teƒe, kple sukuu gbagbe le ŋgɔgbe.

text: First of all, social media encourages our lives.
ref: Gbã la, hadomenyatakakadzraɖoƒewo dea míaƒe agbenɔnɔ ƒe dzi ƒo.
translated: Gbã la, social media naa dzidzo ɖe agbe miaƒe me.

text: In a meeting to discuss the training of teachers, the Chief Director of the Ministry of Education, Divine Ayidzoe, said that the examination will be based on two core subjects: Numeracy and Literacy.
ref: Le kpekpe aɖe si me wodzro nufialawo ƒe hehexɔxɔ me le me la, Sukudede ƒe Dɔdzikpɔlagã, Divine Ayidzoe, gblɔ be dodokpɔa anɔ te ɖe nusɔsrɔ̃ vevi eve dzi: xexlẽdzesi kple nuŋɔŋlɔdzesi.
translated: Le ƒuƒoƒo aɖe si woɖo be woaɖo nuɖoɖo le nufialawo ƒe azãzã ŋu me la, Nufiala Gãto ƒe Dɔwɔƒe ƒe Ðoɖa Gãto, Divine Ayidzoe, gblɔ be dodokpɔ la anɔ nuɖoɖo eve dzi: Akɔntabubu kple Nuŋɔŋlɔ-Nuxexle.

text: Others from the Minority side include Tongu North Member of Parliament Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa, Klottey-Korle Member of Parliament, Dr. Zenator Agyeman-Rawlings and Akatsi South Member of Parliament, Bernard Ahiafor.
ref: Ame bubu siwo tso Ame Suesuewo ƒe akpa dzi dometɔ aɖewoe nye Tongu Dziehe Sewɔtakpekpe me tɔ Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa, Klottey-Korle Sewɔtakpekpe me tɔ, Ðɔkta Zenator Agyeman-Rawlings kple Akatsi Anyiehe Sewɔtakpekpe me tɔ, Bernard Ahiafor.
translated: Ame bubuwo tso Minority me la dzi Tongu North Parliamenttɔ Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa, Klottey-Korle Parliamenttɔ, Dr. Zenator Agyeman-Rawlings kple Akatsi South Parliamenttɔ, Bernard Ahiafor.

text: The village leader writes down the names of the people interested.
ref: Kɔƒea ƒe ŋgɔnɔla ŋlɔa ame siwo tsɔ ɖe le eme la ƒe ŋkɔwo ɖi.
translated: Kɔ̃ɖufia la ŋlɔa ame siame le eŋu dzi la ƒe ŋkɔwo ɖa.

text: At the age of sixty-five years, he retired from his career, but unfortunately, the funds left him by the company were so small, that they could not care for him in any way.
ref: Esi wòxɔ ƒe blaade vɔ atɔ̃ la, exɔ dzudzɔ le eƒe dɔwɔɖuia me, gake nublanuitɔe la, ga si dɔwɔƒea gblẽ ɖi nɛ la nɔ sue ale gbegbe, ale gbegbe be womete ŋu kpɔ edzi le mɔ aɖeke nu o.
translated: Le ƒe blaade-atɔ̃ ƒe ŋu la, eɖe go le eƒe dɔwɔƒe, gake nu vɔ̃ aɖe tɔ enye be, ga si dɔwɔƒea tsɔ na eɖi la sue ŋutɔ, ale be matɛnui akpɔ eƒe ɖoɖo le mɔ aɖeke nu o.

text: The church leader was arrested for seducing his female followers into sexual acts.
ref: Wolé sɔlemehakplɔla la le esi wòble eyomedzela nyɔnuwo be woawɔ gbɔdɔnuwo ta.
translated: Hame fia la wɔ ŋkume ɖe eƒe nɔvinɔ nyɔnuwo ŋu be woawɔ agblenɔƒe dɔwɔwɔ, eye wole eŋu.

text: There is an increase in diseases yet drugs in health centres are not enough.
ref: Dɔlélewo le dzidzim ɖe edzi, gake atike siwo le kɔdziwo me mesɔ gbɔ o.
translated: Dɔlelewo ɖe ɖe edzi gake atikewo le vedomekpɔƒewo me mesɔ gbɔ o.

text: It was about Nana Agradaa's imprisonment that Serwaa Amihere, a great and well known GhOne Tv Correspondent commented on Twitter that he had not found any evidence of Agradaa's guilt.
ref: Nana Agradaa ƒe gaxɔmenɔnɔ ŋue Serwaa Amihere, si nye GhOne Tv Nyadzɔdzɔŋlɔla gã aɖe si wonya nyuie la gblɔ le Twitter dzi be yemeke ɖe kpeɖodzi aɖeke ŋu be Agradaa ɖi fɔ o.
translated: Ɖoɖo aɖe tso Nana Agradaa ƒe gaxɔmede ŋu eye Serwaa Amihere, si nye GhOne Tv ƒe nuƒoƒoɖela xɔnuku aɖe, gblɔ eŋu le Twitter dzi be yemedze ɖasede aɖeke si fia be Agradaa ƒo se o.

text: Most of the crops were destroyed thus people have nothing to harvest.
ref: Nukuawo dometɔ akpa gãtɔ gbã, eya ta nuŋeɣi aɖeke mele amewo si o.
translated: Nukunyawo ƒe gã la ƒe wu, eyata ame aɖeke mele nu aɖeke kaa o.

text: In order to avoid controversy, all black ships to be purchased shall be vessels with low taxes on their purchases, and their equipment shall be clean and will contribute to the stability of the national economy;
ref: Be woaƒo asa na nyaʋiʋli la, ameyibɔwo ƒe meli siwo katã woaƒle la nanye tɔdziʋu siwo ƒe adzɔ sue aɖe koe woxena ɖe woƒe nuƒlewo ta, eye woƒe dɔwɔnuwo nanɔ dzadzɛ eye woana dukɔa ƒe ganyawo nali ke;
translated: Bɔbɔe si woaƒo le eƒe me la, ɖoɖo vɔvɔ siwo woaxle la nabu ŋu aɖe ga siwo woxena le woƒe xexlẽ ŋu la kpɔtɔ, eye woƒe nu siwo katã woazãna la nanɔ kɔ, eye woakpe ɖe dukɔa ƒe ga ƒe nɔnɔme nyuie ŋu;

text: Ever heard the name Mr.Bean? And what about KFC? Do you know who started it? You know these people are not Ghanaian?
ref: Èse ŋkɔ si nye Mr. Bean kpɔa? Ke KFC ya ɖe? Ènya amesi dze nua gɔmea? Ènya be menye Ghana-vidzidziwoe ame siawo nye oa?
translated: Wosema ŋkɔ Mr. Bean na wò kpɔ à? Gake KFC la? Nyea dze eƒe ɖoɖo gɔme la, nènya à? Nènya be ame siawo menye Ghanafowo o à?

text: As customs demands, Akan people have made some arrangments that are followed to name a child.
ref: Abe alesi kɔnuwo bia ene la, Akantɔwo wɔ ɖoɖo aɖewo siwo dzi wowɔna tsɔ yɔa ɖevi ƒe ŋkɔ.
translated: Lee se nɔnɔme bia la, Akan tɔwo wɔ ɖoɖo aɖewo si woɖe anyi be woazã na ŋkɔ na vi.

text: Deputy Minister for Energy, Dr Mohammed Amin Adam has made known that the government is ready to exchange gold for oil; the government has made arrangements to engage in this trade.
ref: Ŋusẽnyawo gbɔkpɔla ƒe kpeɖeŋutɔ, Dr Mohammed Amin Adam na wonya be dziɖuɖua le klalo be yeaɖɔli sika ɖe ami teƒe; dziɖuɖua wɔ ɖoɖo be yeaƒo ye ɖokui ɖe asitsatsa sia me.
translated: Dzikpɔla tso Energy ƒe Minista ƒe Teame, Dr Mohammed Amin Adam ɖe fia be gavemɛnt sɔ gbɔ be yeatsɔ sika aɖe ame le ami nui; gavemɛnt wɔ ɖoɖo be yeawɔ asitsatsa sia.

text: Again, it is crucial for us to collaborate with our development partners in the country to alleviate the hardships faced by our citizens.
